dct_title_s: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) UAV imagery and GIS package by camp (November  2019)
dct_description_sm: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities. The package of November 2019 is based on [NPM Site Assessment 16](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-round-16-site-assessment) (during the months of 21st August – 10th October) and NPM most updated drone imagery (as of 23 January 2019). Here below, the complete package by camp: SW Map package KMZ file Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).
